title: Chapter 2922 - 166: Great Witch (2)
content:
Chapter 2922: Chapter 166: Great Witch (2)

It seems as if everyone has forgotten, no one cares.

The few "legends" that do exist are mostly based on the three words "Great Witch," imagined and speculated without concrete evidence.

But Mo Hua is not an ordinary "person." He walks the path of Divine Sense Proving the Dao and is a half-step God, and at the same time, an immensely skilled Formation Master.

He perceives things much deeper than ordinary cultivators.

He can discern that many elements of the Great Wilderness have traces of the Great Witch.

First, according to the Second Elder of the Demon Sect, the Second Grade Twenty-four Patterns Twelve Scripture Taotie Spirit Remains Array originated from the hands of the Great Witch.

And the Taotie Law is an interconnected law chain.

The Taotie Spirit Formation, if related to the Great Witch.

Then the Four Symbols Green Dragon Formation held by Mr. Tu, the Taotie Devouring Formation in the Shrine of Shugubu, and even the Bone Heavy Armor Absolute Formation of Ancestor Shubu are likely linked to the Great Witch...

Moreover, broadly speaking, the entire Great Wilderness, every tribe, all ancestors, whether they used the "Devour and Dragon Transformation" and other laws to artificially piece together the "Four Symbols Array," in order to forge ancestor Barbarian Armor, perhaps behind it all hides the handiwork of the Great Witch...

As for the Four Symbols Sacred Beast Formation, besides the Green Dragon Formation, there should mostly be the Four Symbols White Tiger Formation, Four Symbols Vermilion Bird Formation, Four Symbols Black Tortoise Formation.

The Great Witch, able to use Monster Patterns to "return" piece together the Green Dragon Formation, then the other three should presumably be no problem.

Thus, the Great Witch has created, practically the entire Great Wilderness’s, Four Symbols Sacred Beast Formation system...

Even the so-called Great Wilderness "Four Sacred Beasts," might be creations by the Great Witch on the basis of the Sacred Beast Formation, using monster beasts’ "flesh" along with divine beasts’ "bloodline" to self-sew and manufacture.

Within this is a more sophisticated, ancient "Life Creation Formation."

So sophisticated that with Mo Hua’s current Formation Master thinking, he cannot comprehend at all.

Even if it weren’t for the fortune that the Big Tiger brought, seeing with his own eyes, he wouldn’t dare think in this direction...

All this is interlinked with this "Great Witch."

The entire Great Wilderness’s formation inheritance, yet has countless connections with this Great Witch...

But the name of the Great Witch, hasn’t been left in the history of the Great Wilderness...

Thinking carefully, Mo Hua cannot help but feel a mysterious chill.

Then he couldn’t help but feel a bit doubtful.

Can this Great Witch... truly be so powerful?

If truly reaching such a level, doesn’t it mean he comprehended the complete Taotie Law Chain; created a multitude of Taotie Absolute Array systems, including the Twenty-four Patterns Twelve Scripture Taotie Spirit Corpse Extremist Formation; simultaneously "synthetically" created the Great Wilderness Four Sacred Beasts — Green Dragon, White Tiger, Vermilion Bird, and Xuan Wu — and established a complete set of Great Wilderness Four Symbols Sacred Beast Formation system...

Even possibly, he compiled the bloodline of the Four Sacred Beasts into ancient "Life Formation Patterns," hidden within different monster beasts of the Great Wilderness, passed down by generations...

...

Are these things truly achievable by "humans"?

The person achieving these must be at what realm, holding what kind of shocking creation?

Perhaps Heavenly Dao is giving him a "plugin"?

Mo Hua furrows his brows.

He previously thought that, in terms of formations, he was already "perverse" enough.

Yet unexpectedly now encountering a figure who even he finds "frightening."

No wonder others always say there’s always someone greater, a sky beyond the sky...

Mo Hua deeply sighed, then collected the somewhat despairing "sense of defeat" within his heart, and readjusted his mindset.

In this world, there are no enemies, only strong ones.

Encounter a strong one, then need to learn well.

Realizing others are strong means knowing oneself is "weak."

And only by knowing oneself is "weak," can one learn others’ strengths.

Turn one’s "weakness" into "strength."

Only then can the weak transform to the strong, no mutual counteraction, continuing indomitably to become stronger, to seek the ultimate "Dao."

This is what Tian Xing Jian teaches; a gentleman should continuously strive for self-improvement.

This is also the principle he realized through personal experience while studying at Qianxue State Boundary.

But... saying this, Mo Hua still feels like there’s a mountain weighing on his heart, heavy and ominous, with an unseen shadow looming overhead.

Moreover...

Mo Hua at this moment again couldn’t help but ponder a bit more...

This Twelve Scripture Taotie Spirit Corpse Extremist Formation, truly was an "unintentional" fortuitous gain?

That Demon Sect’s Second Elder, telling about the Barbaric Absolute Formation and the Great Witch was truly a transaction of "persons dying, their words are good?"

Also, why did Mr. Tu execute the Desolate Heaven Blood Sacrifice Formation precisely during my Qian State studies?

Why did the person he worshipped in a goat-headed white-bone Evil God statue hide a secret Taotie Absolute Array, unknowingly?

Who placed this Taotie Absolute Array in the Evil God statue?

The Taotie Absolute Array being extracted by me from the Evil God’s statue head, truly coincidence?

And during the mixed battle on the Taoist Court frontline, it was a Big Tiger with "Sacred Beast" bloodline that brought me into the Barbaric Wilderness.

The entrance to the Barbaric Wilderness was the Wutu Mountain Realm.

Wutu lies in the east of the Great Wilderness, symbolizing fire...

...

These small details, thinking closely is terrifying.

Mo Hua’s back also feels a chill.

The chess game of the Great Wilderness, could it be... always played by others, constantly laying out pieces around me?

Starting from when I began studying at Qianxue State Boundary?

No...

Even before... from childhood, when encountering the Big Tiger only the size of a kitten, were the pieces of this game already laid around me...
